items.title: 'Boomer bashing': Are cuts to private health rebates addressing generational or wealth inequality?
items.description: The federal government plans to reduce private health insurance rebates for older Australians, a move one advocate fears could "tip many over the edge".

items.title: Liberal senator speaks out against Taylor's budget reply
items.description: Senator Andrew McLachlan raises concerns over Angus Taylor's use of the term "mass immigration" and plan to push tax-paying migrants off welfare benefits.

items.title: Live: Albanese rejects claim discretionary trust plan amounts to 'death tax'
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has rejected suggestion the government's planned tax on discretionary trusts amounts to a so-called "death tax". Follow live.

items.title: No Walsh for Queensland as Blues coach accidentally lists former Maroon
items.description: Billy Slater leaves Reece Walsh out of his Queensland side for State of Origin I, while NSW coach Laurie Daley accidentally announces the name of a former Maroon in his squad.

items.title: Trump started the war but people the world over are living in its wake
items.description: It has been more than two months since the US and Israel launched strikes in Iran. But the impact of the conflict continues globally.

items.title: Miles declares 'a win is a win' as Labor squeaks by in by-election
items.description: Labor candidate Luke Richmond will become the next member for Stafford, but the party's vote dropped several points.

items.title: A Canberra woman's husband said not to book return flights. It was a case of exit trafficking
items.description: Advocates for migrant women say they're seeing more cases of exit trafficking — where an offender uses coercion, threats or deception to organise a person's departure from Australia.

items.title: Church warns 'everything's on the table' as redress bill continues to climb
items.description: Tasmania's Anglican Church says what it expects to pay in compensation to victim-survivors of child sexual abuse has more than doubled in the past three years.

items.title: Taiwan president responds after Trump's visit to China
items.description: Speaking after Donald Trump's meeting with China's president, Taiwan's leader says the island will not be sacrificed or traded and will not give up its free way of life.

items.title: Why the US, UK and NZ haven't raised interest rates in years
items.description: As Australians pay more on their mortgages, some countries have had no rise in their interest rate in recent years. So what's going on?

items.title: What to know about the current Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the Congo
items.description: The WHO has declared a global health emergency after more than 80 cases of Ebola were confirmed across two African countries. Here's why the organisation is calling for preparedness, not panic.

items.title: Live: ASX falls after Wall Street losses, AUD also lower, oil up sharply
items.description: The ASX 200 has begun the week in the red, following Wall Street, with both US indexes suffering losses after touching record highs in their last trading sessions. Meanwhile, uncertainty over the Iran war has seen Brent crude oil rise above $110 a barrel. Follow live.

items.title: Young woman killed, three injured in northern NSW crash
items.description: Police are investigating after a car flipped after crashing into a power pole.

items.title: Some NT cases could halt if landmark legal challenge succeeds
items.description: Lawyers in the Northern Territory are commencing a landmark legal challenge that could require courts to halt some cases due to defendants being unable to access a lawyer amid a worsening legal aid crisis.

items.title: The $10b offer Dave Hughes would 'hand on heart' turn down
items.description: Comedian Dave Hughes spoke to The Assembly about why he quit alcohol at 22, being "addicted to work" and the type of dad he's trying to be for his three kids.

items.title: How an Australian designer's fashion fame spurred a mental health unravelling
items.description: Rochelle Gregory has clothed everyone from Paris Hilton to Dua Lipa. Now the designer is using film to candidly explore her mental health battle while showcasing her latest collection.

items.title: Reasons it's so hard to end a long-term relationship, even when you want to
items.description: It's not just practical and emotional reasons that get in the way of executing a break-up. There are many ways your brain is making you want to stay.

items.title: Qld developer donation overhaul yields $170,000 in cash
items.description: More than $170,000 in donations from developers has been given to Queensland state politicians since laws banning developer donations were overturned in March.

items.title: 'Make it legal next time': Another blistering 100m for Aussie Nketia
items.description: For the second time this year, Eddie Nketia stops the clock in what would be an Australian record for the 100m, but is aided by an illegal tailwind.

items.title: The gas that could make Australia a player in global semiconductor supply chain
items.description: Helium is used in health care and to make microchips and semiconductors, but the Middle East war has affected supply. Some think it is an opportunity for Australia's gas industry.

items.title: Mass showers and squalor: What spurred ex-Labor minister's NDIS fight
items.description: A former NSW Labor powerbroker and state disability minister pivotal in advocating for the establishment of the NDIS has warned against rushing through sweeping changes to the scheme.

items.title: Murder accused to remain in custody after man's death north of Bundaberg
items.description: Yutthawichan Phetrchaisak is remanded in custody after being charged with the murder of a 42-year-old man north of Bundaberg.

items.title: Person dies after north Canberra unit gutted by fire
items.description: Emergency services were called to the Wallcliffe Flats in Belconnen at about 6:30am where they found a ground-floor unit alight.

items.title: Pilots parachute from jets after mid-flight collision at US air show
items.description: Two fighter jets have collided mid-air during an air show at a US Air Force base, forcing pilots to eject and parachute to safety.

items.title: Tax is a great motivator but will Labor's changes fix Australia's housing mess?
items.description: The Albanese government and the opposition both want to turn back the clock on the Australian tax system.
